jobs.title: Growth Manager - Asia
jobs.description_text: Ellipsis Labs is a profitable, venture-backed New York-based startup building sustainable and efficient DeFi protocols on high-throughput decentralized infrastructure. Our long-term goal is to build a better financial system. Our flagship product, Phoenix Perpetuals, brings professional-grade perpetual futures to Solana. Building on our experience developing efficient markets, Ellipsis Labs also operates SolFi, a proprietary automated market maker that provides efficient liquidity for key trading pairs. Our foundational product, Phoenix Legacy, is a limit order book on the Solana blockchain that established our expertise in operating high-performance markets. Combined, these products have facilitated over $285B in trading volume across Solana markets. Ellipsis Labs is seeking a Growth Manager to build and activate our presence across Asian crypto markets. Our go-to-market today is largely driven by social media, and we need boots on the ground to develop the local relationships, market intelligence, and trust that a remote presence can't replicate. This is an early and high-ownership role: you will be the company's primary bridge to one of the most important trading ecosystems in the world. In this role, you will: - Map the Asian crypto trading landscape, including understanding who the key retail traders, whale accounts, and market makers are, where they're active, and what they care about - Build and cultivate relationships with high-value traders and ecosystem participants

jobs.title: APAC Partner Business Development Manager
jobs.description_text: COMPANY OVERVIEW Deepgram is the leading platform underpinning the emerging trillion-dollar Voice AI economy, providing real-time APIs for speech-to-text (STT), text-to-speech (TTS), and building production-grade voice agents at scale. More than 200,000 developers and 1,300+ organizations build voice offerings that are ‘Powered by Deepgram’, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Daily, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box. Deepgram’s voice-native foundation models are accessed through cloud APIs or as self-hosted and on-premises software, with unmatched accuracy, low latency, and cost efficiency. Backed by a recent Series C led by leading global investors and strategic partners, Deepgram has processed over 50,000 years of audio and transcribed more than 1 trillion words. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram. COMPANY OPERATING RHYTHM At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset—AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance. Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries

jobs.title: 视频数据标注 & 评测专家 / 负责人
jobs.description_text: 岗位职责 视频标注 • 设计并落地各类视频标注任务与规范:caption(prompt 与视频内容对齐)、动作(action)、场景(scene)、风格、镜头 / 运镜、时序一致性、ranking / preference、badcase 分类等。 • 搭建标注质检体系:gold set、抽检、多轮 review、一致性(IAA)、reviewer 校准,保障大批量标注质量稳定可迭代。 • 管理标注供应商 / 众包团队,控制交付质量、一致性与返工。 • 根据模型 badcase 持续迭代标注规范(guideline)与标准。 视频评测 • 搭建视频生成评测体系:评测集 / benchmark 构建,评测维度与指标设计(画质、动作自然度、时序一致性、prompt 匹配度、坏帧 / 变形 / 闪烁等),人工 + 自动评测结合。 • 建立 badcase 分类与回流机制,把评测结果转化为可执行的数据补充和标注规范调整。 • 支持多版本模型对比,跟踪数据使用效果与模型改进。 协同 • 与算法团队对接,理解 PT / SFT / RLHF / Eval 各阶段对数据的不同要求,推动数据标准持续迭代。 任职要求 • 3 年以上相关经验,做过视频 / 图像 / 多模态数据的标注或评测(非纯文本 NLP)。 • 亲手做过相关工作,能清楚讲解不同视频标注任务之间的差异和具体做法。 • 熟悉标注质检体系,在 gold set、抽检、IAA、reviewer 校准等机制上至少有一套实操经验。 • 有与算法团队协作、推动 badcase 回流的经验。 • 较强的流程梳理与跨团队沟通能力。 加分项 • 直接做过视频生成 / T2V / VLM / 多模态模型的训练数据或评测。 • 理解 SFT / RLHF,清楚偏好数据与 ranking 在其中的作用。 • 管理过标注供应商 / 众包 / 专家团队,并能把控交付质量。 • 有从 0 到 1 搭建标注或评测流程的经验。

jobs.title: 视频生成模型 · 训练 Infra 工程师
jobs.description_text: 我们在训练自研视频生成基础模型(DiT / Flow Matching),需要一位既能搭起训练平台、又能把研究代码变成数百卡集群上稳定结果的工程师。你不只是用平台的人,更是建平台的人。 你会做 • 训练平台搭建:从作业调度、断点续训、监控告警到数据 / 权重流水线,把分散的脚本沉淀为团队可复用的训练基础设施。 • 数百卡规模的分布式训练:FSDP、张量并行、Context Parallel、Ulysses,把 MFU 推到合理水位。 • PB 级视频数据 pipeline:NVDEC 解码、VAE latent 缓存、变分辨率 bucket sampling。 • 显存与性能:FlashAttention、FP8 混合精度、Triton kernel、activation checkpoint 策略。 • 训练稳定性:loss spike 根因分析、断点秒级恢复、慢节点自动剔除。 硬性要求 • 精通 PyTorch distributed 与 CUDA 体系结构。 • 至少一个主流训练框架(Megatron / DeepSpeed / FSDP / TorchTitan)的源码级理解。 • ≥ 256 卡训练实战经验。 • 有从零或半程搭建训练平台 / 集群调度 / 训练工具链的经验。 加分 • DiT / Diffusion / 视频数据处理经验。 • 写过 Triton / CUTLASS kernel。 • 对 HunyuanVideo / Wan / CogVideoX 等开源项目有源码级了解。 我们提供 • 真实数百卡算力、把训练当工程问题的团队、合规边界内的开源 / 发表空间。

jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff
jobs.description_text: ABOUT GENERAL INTUITION General Intuition is the frontier lab for acting in space and time. We build large action models and world models that can perceive, predict, and act across virtual and physical environments. General Intuition builds on the strength of Medal, the world's largest and fastest-growing platform for gaming clips, where millions of gamers capture, share, and discover new games every year. We recently raised $320M at a $2.3B valuation led by Khosla Ventures with participation from General Catalyst, Eric Schmidt, and Jeff Bezos, to discover the next generation of real-world intelligence. THE ROLE We train action policies and world models on the largest corpus of action-labeled gaming data in the world. Member of Technical Staff is the title everyone in our technical team holds. Each MTS is not fit to a single role - we help you find the most important problem across research, engineering, and infrastructure that aligns with our team's ambitious roadmap and fits your strengths. Tell us what you're exceptional at, and show us the corresponding work to illustrate your skills.

jobs.title: Strategy & Operations
jobs.description_text: ABOUT US Forus is building an AI-powered network that connects doctors, pharmacies, payers, and biopharma to accelerate new science to patients. Our platform automates the complexity between a doctor prescribing a medicine and a patient starting treatment, including insurance coverage, financial assistance, and supply chain navigation. We provide this support free to doctors and patients, helping them get life-changing medicine faster, cheaper, and easier. The resulting network enables biopharma companies to design better research, launch new drugs more effectively, and invest in harder-to-treat conditions. Forus has exceptional product-market fit and is growing rapidly through organic adoption: - Accelerating scale: We already support patients across more than 85% of ZIP codes and partner with 9 of top 15 largest biopharma companies in the world. - AI-native, durable model: Our business becomes stronger as AI improves, as every new doctor, patient, and partner makes the network more valuable. - Backing to build for the long term: We raised $300M+ from leading investors to build an exceptional team and unlock the full scale of the opportunity. Our number one priority is scaling to market demand. We are looking for individuals who are high horsepower, high throughput, and hyper resourceful to help us increase capacity and grow. We provide this support free to doctors and patients, helping them get life-changing medicine faster, cheaper, and easier. The resulting network enables biopharma companies to design better research, launch new drugs more effectively, and invest in harder-to-treat conditions. Forus has exceptional product-market fit and is growing rapidly through organic adoption: - Accelerating scale: We already support patients across more than 85% of ZIP codes and partner with 9 of top 15 largest biopharma companies in the world. - AI-native, durable model: Our business becomes stronger as AI improves, as every new doctor, patient, and partner makes the network more valuable. - Backing to build for the long term: We raised $300M+ from leading investors to build an exceptional team and unlock the full scale of the opportunity. Our number one priority is scaling to market demand. We are looking for individuals who are high horsepower, high throughput, and hyper resourceful to help us increase capacity and grow. We move fast and need to move faster. If we succeed, science will be the only limit to medicine. All full-time roles are in person in New York. ABOUT T

jobs.description_text: About Us GenMD is unlocking healthcare data at scale. Today, roughly 97% of healthcare data goes unused because of patient privacy concerns. We’ve found a way to unlock that data—safely and ethically—for AI labs, pharma companies, and researchers. This isn’t a chatbot, or an AI agent replacing clinicians or automating paperwork. It’s core infrastructure that enables better drugs, faster clinical trials, and more powerful medical research—the kind of foundation that makes real breakthroughs, including curing diseases, possible. The company was built out of years inside Stanford Medicine, working closely with world-class researchers and clinicians. We have access to tens of millions of patients, longitudinal health records, and clinical notes. GenMD is just coming out of stealth, already revenue-generating, well-funded, and backed by premier investors with years of runway. We’re intentionally small, move fast, and are focused on building something fundamental. jobs.description_text: PEOPLE & FINANCE LEAD $80,000 - $140,000 + 0.02% - 0.12% Somerville, MA ABOUT GLIMPSE The last decade has been incredibly exciting for electric mobility. However, the electrification of the transportation industry has scaled while relying on an insufficient set of quality control tools. This has led to uncomfortably high rates of battery pack failure and multi-billion-dollar safety recalls. In our view, every headline of electric vehicles and e-bikes catching fire is a major impediment towards an all-electric future. After having spent a few years in the trenches of battery and electric vehicle factories at Tesla and Toyota, Glimpse’s cofounders set out to build a technology to enable battery quality at scale. In 2024, Glimpse launched the Glimpse Portal, the first scalable X-ray-powered quality management platform for battery cells. After quadrupling revenue in 2025, Glimpse is now expanding into new hardware industries that rely too heavily on an outdated X-ray scanning technology stack to control the quality of their parts. Today, Glimpse serves over 90 customers, including some of the world’s largest battery companies and OEMs, such as NASA, Anker, Lucid Motors, the Navy, and several hyperscalers. Able to evaluate companies targeting global markets - Comfortable talking to founders and asking direct, thoughtful questions - Strong judgment, high curiosity, and bias for action - Able to form an independent view and clearly explain why a deal is interesting or not Nice to have - Experience with cross-border business, overseas expansion, or global GTM - Background in startups, venture, PE, IB, consulting, or strategy - Existing network among Chinese founders building for the US, Europe, or SEA 风险投资实习生 你将专注于发掘和评估中国及跨境创业公司，尤其是面向海外和全球市场的项目。本岗位以创始人外联、一线沟通和早期投资判断为核心，偏执行、强实战。 职责 - 主动挖掘中国及大中华区的早期创业公司，重点关注跨境或全球化方向 - 通过微信、邮件、LinkedIn、活动及熟人介绍等方式

jobs.title: Lifecycle Manager
jobs.description_text: We are looking for a data-driven, creative, and highly technical Lifecycle Manager to own our customer retention strategy. Your primary playground will be Klaviyo, and your North Star metric will be Customer Lifetime Value (LTV). This isn't a role for a generalist—we need someone who has lived and breathed e-commerce, understands the nuances of a high-growth brand, and knows how to turn a one-time buyer into a lifelong advocate. WHAT YOU’LL DO - Klaviyo Mastery: Own the full execution of our email and SMS strategy. This includes sophisticated segmentation, high-converting automated flows (Welcome, Abandoned Cart, Post-Purchase, Win-back), and a high-frequency campaign calendar. - LTV Optimization: Analyze customer cohorts to identify churn points and opportunities for upsells or cross-sells. You will be responsible for moving the needle on repeat purchase rates and average order value (AOV). - A/B Testing & Optimization: Maintain a rigorous testing roadmap. You’ll constantly experiment with subject lines, send times, content blocks, and incentive structures to squeeze every ounce of ROI out of our list. - Personalization & Segmentation: Move beyond "batch and blast." Use predictive analytics and behavioral data to deliver the right message to the right person at the right time. - Collaboration: Work closely with the Creative team to ensure every touchpoint is on-brand and high-converting, and with the Product team to align lifecycle triggers with the on-site experience. - Rep

jobs.title: Personal Assistant - NYC
jobs.description_text: We are looking for a reliable, organized Personal Assistant in New York City to help a couple based in the West Village with day-to-day logistics, errands, scheduling, and personal coordination. The couple works from home most days, and this role is needed a few days per week rather than full time. There are no children in the household; this is a practical support role for someone who is detail-oriented, responsive, discreet, and comfortable handling a mix of in-person errands and light administrative coordination. You should be comfortable working around a private household, coordinating with both people clearly, and keeping small tasks from becoming distractions. The right person has good judgment, protects privacy, follows through without needing constant reminders, and can keep a running list of open items moving. RESPONSIBILITIES - Help a couple with personal scheduling, reminders, appointments, reservations, and follow-ups - Run errands and coordinate local logistics around the West Village and greater New York City a few days per week - Help with purchases, returns, deliveries, household supplies, and simple personal admin - Coordinate with building staff, vendors, service providers, cleaners, repair people, and external contacts - Track open tasks, confirm details, and make sure loose ends are closed - Prepare simple notes, lists, summaries, and updates when needed - Handle personal information, home access, and scheduling details with discretion and care REQUIREMENT

jobs.title: 硬件采购经理 Hardware Sourcing Manager
jobs.description_text: 职位概述 我们是一家在深圳和纽约运营的初创公司，正在打造 AI 智能体和消费级硬件设备。用户可以通过智能体在不同工具中执行操作，我们也在开发能够随时捕捉用户意图的定制设备。团队规模精简，创始人曾创办一家硅谷独角兽公司。 我们正在寻找一位硬件采购经理，负责为多个客户项目寻找、评估并协调大湾区的硬件工厂、设备供应商和制造合作伙伴。你将经常前往深圳、东莞、广州、珠海、佛山及周边产业带，把客户需求推进为可执行的打样、生产和交付计划。 工作内容 - 走访硬件工厂、组装厂、模具厂、电子元器件供应商和设备供应商。 - 根据不同客户的产品需求、预算、质量标准和时间表筛选供应商。 - 收集报价、规格、认证、产能、起订量、交期和付款条件，整理中英文对比和建议。 - 协调 NDA、RFQ、打样、工程验证、工厂审核、试产、量产、质量检查、包装和物流。 - 现场检查样品、生产线和关键工艺，拍摄照片和视频，并及时汇报。 - 同时推进多个客户项目，跟踪风险、决策、截止时间和下一步行动。 - 与客户、工程师、工业设计师、工厂负责人和物流合作伙伴保持清晰沟通。 任职要求 - 常驻深圳或大湾区，能够频繁前往深圳、东莞、广州、珠海、佛山及周边工厂。 - 有消费电子、智能硬件、IoT、可穿戴设备、电子元器件、模具或组装采购经验。 - 能够独立完成供应商搜寻、询价、谈判、工厂走访、样品跟进和项目协调。 - 理解打样、BOM、DFM、EVT、DVT、PVT 等硬件开发和制造流程。 - 中文沟通能力强，并能使用英文进行客户更新、书面总结和会议沟通。 - 做事有条理、反应快，能够同时管理多个客户项目。 加分项 - 在大湾区拥有成熟的硬件工厂、电子市场、模具、SMT、组装或设备供应商网络。 - 有从概念、样品到量产和交付的完整项目经验。 - 熟悉质量体系、工厂审核、产品认证、进出口或跨境物流。 申请说明 请说明你做过的硬件或设备采购项目、你熟悉的工厂和产业带、你能够覆盖的大湾区城市，以及你如何同时协调多个客户项目。如有相关项目案例，请附上链接。 ROLE OVERVIEW We are a startup building AI agents and consumer devices. Users prompt agents to take actions across their tools, while our custom devices capture intent on the go. We are a small team in Shenzhen and New York, and our founder previously started a Silicon Valley unicorn. We are looking for a Hardware Sourcing Manager to identify, evaluate, and coordinate hardware factories, device suppliers, and manufacturing partners for projects across multiple clients. You will travel frequently throughout the Greater Bay Area, including Shenzhen, Dongguan, Guangzhou, Zhuhai, Foshan, and nearby manufacturing hubs. RESPONSIBILITIE

jobs.title: 家具采购代理 - 佛山 / Furniture Shopping Agent - Foshan
jobs.description_text: 职位概况 我们正在寻找一位位于佛山或周边地区的兼职合同制家具采购与物流代理，协助一个定制住宅项目完成家具、家居材料及相关物流的实地采购工作。你将根据设计师和业主家庭的需求，走访佛山及周边家具市场、展厅、工厂、仓库和供应商，收集报价、照片、视频和规格信息，并协助推进下单、付款、验货、包装、运输和交付安排。 工作内容 - 走访佛山及周边城市的家具市场、展厅、工厂、仓库和供应商。 - 根据设计需求、预算、尺寸、材质和时间要求寻找合适家具选项。 - 拍摄清晰照片和视频，收集报价，确认规格，并整理选项供业主审核。 - 在合适情况下协助谈价和确认条款，帮助筛选可靠供应商。 - 协调下单、付款、验货、包装、本地运输、出口或国内物流以及交付时间。 - 用英文和中文与业主家庭、设计师、供应商和物流方清晰沟通。 - 用简单共享表格或文档跟踪价格、联系人、决策和下一步事项。 任职要求 - 常驻佛山，或能够经常前往佛山家具市场和供应商处。 - 中文沟通能力强；具备用于更新、总结和电话沟通的英文能力。 - 有家具采购、室内设计采购、出口物流、买手或采购代理等实地采购经验。 - 对质量、材质、饰面、尺寸和实际交付细节有判断力。 - 能够独立走访供应商，快速推进，并提供有条理的更新。 - 做事可靠透明，能谨慎处理报价、付款、时间线和供应商沟通。 加分项 - 在佛山、乐从、顺德或周边家具产业带有现成供应商资源。 - 有定制家具、住宅装修项目或国际运输经验。 - 能够检查样品、饰面、软包、木材、石材、金属、灯具或相关家居材料。 申请问题 - 请简要说明你与家具采购、供应商协调或物流相关的经验。 - 请说明你通常能前往佛山家具市场或供应商处的频率。 - 如有相关项目照片、供应商案例、采购表格或作品集，请附上链接。 ROLE OVERVIEW We are looking for a part-time contract furniture sourcing and logistics agent based in Foshan or nearby. This is a one-time project for a custom family home after the design is complete. You will help source furniture and related home materials, visit suppliers in person, collect quotes and specifications, and coordinate the practical details from selection through ordering, inspection, packing, transport, and delivery. RESPONSIBILITIES - Visit furniture markets, showrooms, factories, warehouses, and suppliers in Foshan and nearby cities. - Source furniture options that match the design brief, budget, dimensions, materials, and timing. - Take clear photos and videos, collect quotes, confirm specifications, and organize opti

jobs.title: Brand Partnerships Manager 品牌合作经理
jobs.description_text: Italic 正在深圳招聘一名商务拓展与合作经理，负责接触和筛选中国品牌，推动他们通过 Italic 进入美国市场。这个岗位会和中国品牌方、工厂、创始人及渠道团队沟通，判断品牌和产品是否适合美国消费者，并推动从初次接触、商业方案、样品评估到合作落地的全过程。 我们希望候选人有 3-5 年零售、电商、品牌方、平台或分销相关的 BD、商务拓展、销售或合作伙伴经验。这个角色适合喜欢主动开拓、能把复杂合作讲清楚、并且能在中美商业语境之间切换的人。 工作职责 - 主动寻找、接触和跟进适合进入美国市场的中国消费品牌，重点关注家居、生活方式、服饰配件、美妆个护、消费电子及其他高潜力品类。 - 向品牌方清楚介绍 Italic 的美国市场分销、渠道和品牌增长机会，判断对方的需求、能力和合作意向。 - 建立并维护品牌候选名单、联系人、跟进状态、样品进度、商业条款和下一步行动。 - 和品牌方讨论基础合作条款，包括产品范围、供货能力、价格区间、渠道限制、市场支持和美国分销安排。 - 协调内部团队评估品牌和产品机会，包括产品质量、价格竞争力、供应稳定性、包装、合规风险和美国市场适配度。 - 推动从冷启动外联、初次会议、样品寄送、资料收集、商业沟通到合作落地的完整流程。 - 整理市场和品牌情报，持续发现中国品牌出海、跨境电商、DTC、Amazon、TikTok Shop 和零售渠道中的新机会。 - 和深圳及美国团队保持清晰沟通，及时同步进展、风险、阻塞点和需要决策的事项。 任职要求 - 常驻深圳，能够线下拜访品牌方、供应商、展会或合作伙伴。 - 3-5 年 BD、商务拓展、销售、渠道合作、品牌合作或平台招商经验，优先考虑零售、电商、消费品牌、跨境电商或分销相关背景。 - 有主动开发客户或合作伙伴的经验，能独立完成外联、会议沟通、跟进和推进。 - 理解中国品牌出海到美国市场时常见的问题，包括定位、渠道、定价、包装、合规、库存和品牌信任。 - 沟通清楚、反应快，能够把 Italic 的合作模式讲得具体、有说服力。 - 有较强的商业判断力，能快速判断一个品牌是否值得继续推进。 - 做事有条理，能长期维护大量线索、联系人和合作进度。 - 普通话流利，能用英文进行书面沟通；如果能进行英文商务会议更好。 加分项 - 有跨境电商、Amazon、Shopify、TikTok Shop、海外分销或美国零售渠道经验。 - 有消费品品牌方、贸易公司、平台招商、渠道销售或品牌代理经验。 - 熟悉深圳、广州、东莞、义乌、杭州等地的品牌、供应链或展会资源。 - 做过品牌出海、美国市场进入、分销代理、渠道合作或商务谈判。 - 能用 CRM、表格或其他工具清晰管理线索和销售漏斗。 Italic is hiring a Business Development & Partnerships Manager in Shenzhen to identify and work with Chinese brands that want to enter the U.S. market, with Italic acting as their U.S. distributor. This role owns outreach, qualification, relationship management, commercial discussion, sample coordination, and the handoff from promising brand lead to active partnershi

jobs.title: 亚马逊平台运营经理 / Amazon Marketplace Operations Manager
jobs.description_text: Italic 正在深圳招聘一名亚马逊平台运营经理，负责 Seller Central 的日常经营、账户健康、Listing 质量、FBA 库存、促销节奏和跨团队执行。 工作职责 • 管理 Listing 创建与优化、变体、A+ 内容和品牌旗舰店。 • 监控账户健康、绩效通知、合规问题和申诉，及时闭环异常。 • 跟踪销售、转化率、ACOS、TACOS、库存周转和缺货风险，输出周报。 • 协调 FBA 补货、入仓、IPI、超龄库存和大促备货。 • 维护运营 SOP，并与产品、物流和品牌团队推动落地。 任职要求 • 常驻深圳，2 年以上 Amazon Seller Central 实操经验。 • 熟悉 Listing、账户健康、FBA 库存和促销的完整工作流。 • 熟练使用 Excel 或 Google Sheets，能从数据中发现问题。 • 能用英文处理 Seller Support Case，工作有条理、稳定可靠。 English Italic is hiring an Amazon Marketplace Operations Manager in Shenzhen to run Seller Central operations, account health, listing quality, FBA inventory, promotions, and cross-functional execution. Responsibilities • Manage listings, variations, A+ content, Brand Store maintenance, and account health. • Track sales, conversion, ACOS, TACOS, inventory turns, and stockout risk; produce useful weekly reports. • Coordinate FBA replenishment, inbound shipments, IPI, aged inventory, and peak-event readiness. • Maintain clear SOPs and close issues with product, logistics, and brand teams. Requirements • Based in Shenzhen with 2+ years of hands-on Seller Central experience. • Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills and clear written English for Seller Support cases. • Organized, reliable, and able to independently own operating details.

jobs.title: 亚马逊广告与增长经理 / Amazon PPC & Growth Manager
jobs.description_text: Italic 正在深圳招聘一名亚马逊广告与增长经理，重点负责 Amazon PPC、关键词策略、预算效率和促销增长。这个岗位不是纯执行，需要能把广告数据与 Listing、价格、库存和利润联系起来。 工作职责 • 规划并优化 Sponsored Products、Sponsored Brands 和 Sponsored Display。 • 管理预算、竞价、搜索词、否定关键词和商品投放。 • 跟踪 ACOS、TACOS、ROAS、CTR、CVR、自然排名和贡献利润。 • 建立广告测试计划，评估新词、新素材、新 ASIN 和促销增量。 • 与内容、运营和库存团队协作，避免广告增长造成缺货或利润损失。 任职要求 • 常驻深圳，2 年以上 Amazon PPC 实操经验。 • 能展示实际账户、预算规模、优化方法和量化结果。 • 熟练使用 Seller Central、Advertising Console 和数据表格。 • 理解 Listing 转化、FBA 库存、定价和促销之间的关系。 English Italic is hiring an Amazon PPC & Growth Manager in Shenzhen to own paid search, keyword strategy, budget efficiency, and promotional growth across Amazon. Responsibilities • Build and optimize SP, SB, and SD campaigns across bids, search terms, negatives, and product targeting. • Report on ACOS, TACOS, ROAS, CTR, CVR, organic rank, and contribution margin. • Run a disciplined testing roadmap for keywords, creative, ASINs, and promotional offers. • Coordinate with listing, inventory, and merchandising owners so growth remains profitable and in stock. Requirements • Based in Shenzhen with 2+ years of hands-on Amazon PPC experience. • Able to discuss real account structures, budget levels, optimization decisions, and measured outcomes. • Strong analytical skills and practical understanding of listing conversion, pricing, and FBA inventory.

jobs.title: 智能硬件供应商开发经理 / Smart Hardware Supplier Development Manager
jobs.description_text: 我们正在深圳招聘一名智能硬件供应商开发经理，为小型 AI 设备和消费电子产品寻找、评估并管理供应商。你将把不完整的产品需求转化为可报价、可打样、可量产的供应方案。 工作职责 • 寻找并评估结构件、电子件、模具、表面处理、包装和整机供应商。 • 管理 RFQ、成本拆解、比价、谈判、样品和供应商准入。 • 与工业设计、机械、电子和工厂团队审查图纸、BOM、工艺与交期。 • 跟进试产和量产问题，推动质量、成本和交付改进。 • 建立供应商数据库、风险分级、双供策略和清晰的采购记录。 任职要求 • 常驻深圳，3 年以上消费电子或智能硬件供应商开发经验。 • 熟悉珠三角供应链，能独立找厂、验厂、询价和谈判。 • 能看懂 CAD/STP、2D 图纸和 BOM，并与工程师讨论 DFM。 • 中英文沟通清晰，执行力强，愿意频繁跑工厂。 English We are hiring a Smart Hardware Supplier Development Manager in Shenzhen to source and qualify suppliers for compact AI devices and consumer electronics. Responsibilities • Source mechanical, electronic, tooling, finishing, packaging, and assembly partners. • Own RFQs, cost breakdowns, negotiations, samples, qualification, and supplier records. • Review CAD/STP files, drawings, BOMs, processes, and lead times with design, engineering, and factories. • Drive quality, cost, delivery, dual-source, and production-risk improvements. Requirements • Based in Shenzhen with 3+ years of supplier development experience in consumer electronics or smart hardware. • Strong Pearl River Delta factory network and hands-on RFQ, audit, and negotiation experience. • Able to read CAD/STP, drawings, and BOMs and discuss DFM with engineers.

jobs.title: 消费电子 NPI 与采购经理 / Consumer Electronics NPI & Sourcing Manager
jobs.description_text: 我们正在深圳招聘一名消费电子 NPI 与采购经理，负责把新产品从工程样机推进到可稳定量产。这个岗位连接设计、工程、供应商和工厂，重点是试产节奏、BOM 成本、物料齐套、质量和交付。 工作职责 • 制定 EVT、DVT、PVT 和量产爬坡的采购及物料计划。 • 管理 BOM 报价、成本目标、长交期物料、替代料和采购风险。 • 跟进模具、样品、试产、工程变更和量产问题闭环。 • 与工程和供应商审查 DFM、质量标准、测试要求与交期。 • 建立 NPI 看板，清楚呈现成本、进度、缺料和关键风险。 任职要求 • 常驻深圳，3 年以上消费电子 NPI、项目采购或供应链项目经验。 • 熟悉 EVT/DVT/PVT、BOM、ECN、模具和试产工作流。 • 能看懂图纸和规格，能在成本、质量与速度之间做判断。 • Excel/Sheets 熟练，中英文沟通清晰，能独立推动多方交付。 English We are hiring a Consumer Electronics NPI & Sourcing Manager in Shenzhen to take new devices from engineering prototype through stable mass production. Responsibilities • Own sourcing and material readiness across EVT, DVT, PVT, and ramp. • Manage BOM quotes, cost targets, long-lead parts, alternates, samples, tooling, and change orders. • Close production issues with engineering, suppliers, and factories; maintain a clear NPI risk dashboard. • Review DFM, quality standards, test requirements, and lead times.
